name: Industrial & Infrastructure Fund Investment Corporation
summary: Industrial & Infrastructure Fund Investment Corporation based on (Act on Investment Trust and Investment Corporation) (hereinafter referred to as Investment Trust Law) and became listed on the J-REIT market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Based on the principle of aiming to invest in social infrastructure as a source of power for the Japanese economy and support Japan's industrial activities from a perspective of real estate, IIF invests and manages logistics facilities, manufacturing and research and development (R&D) facilities, and infrastructure facilities which play a vital role in various industrial activities as the only listed J REIT specializing in industrial properties.
